stories.title: Michael Locke (stuntman)
stories.about: Michael Richard Locke, better known as Pancho, was a Welsh professional stuntman and skateboarder. He was best known for MTV UK's Dirty Sanchez.

stories.title: Kimmarie Johnson
stories.about: Kimmarie Johnson was an American actress, model, businesswoman and beauty pageant titleholder. She was the founder of SkinGlow by Kimmarie, a skin care and beauty retailing and consulting company she founded in 2011.
stories.headline: Johnson suffered a heart-related medical emergency at her home in Los Angeles, California, on October 27, 2026, and was hospitalized at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center…

stories.title: Jay Rockefeller
stories.about: John Davison "Jay" Rockefeller IV was an American politician who served as a United States senator from West Virginia from 1985 to 2015 and previously as governor of West Virginia from 1977 to 1985. He was a member of the Democratic Party.
stories.headline: Jay Rockefeller died at his home in Washington, D.C., on November 6, 2026, at the age of 89.

stories.title: Ramayana: Part 1
stories.about: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the epic poem Ramayana by Valmiki. It is the first of a two-part film, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana which chronicles the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Sunny Deol, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.
stories.headline: Ramayana: Part 1 premiered at the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures on 27 October 2026, and was released worldwide on 5 November, on occasion of Diwali.

stories.title: Scene (2026 film)
stories.about: Scene is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film written and directed by Jithu Madhavan. Produced by Suriya and Jyothika's 2D Entertainment and the newly established Zhagaram Studios, the film stars Suriya, Naslen and Nazriya Nazim. It revolves around a police officer being forced to reopen an unfinished case and solve it with a troublesome team.
stories.headline: Scene was released on 6 November 2026, in the week of Diwali and received mostly positive reviews from critics.

stories.title: 2026 United States elections
stories.about: Elections in the United States were held on November 3, 2026. In these midterm elections, which occurred during the non-consecutive second term of incumbent Republican president Donald Trump, all 435 seats in the U.S. House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 seats in the U.S. Senate were contested to determine the 120th United States Congress. Thirty-nine state and territorial U.S. gubernatorial elections, attorney general elections, and numerous state and local elections were also contested. The Democratic Party won a majority of seats in both houses of Congress and among state governorships across the United States.

stories.title: The Paraguayan Senate unanimously removes Santiago Peña as country's president…
stories.summary: The Paraguayan Senate unanimously removes Santiago Peña as country's president over alleged conflicts of interest involving Ueno Bank, whose accounts the central bank froze. Congress postpones consideration of Peña's resignation to allow impeachment proceedings.
stories.headline: The Paraguayan Senate unanimously removes Santiago Peña as country's president over alleged conflicts of interest involving Ueno Bank, whose accounts the central bank froze…

stories.title: 2028 United States Senate elections
stories.summary: Senate election for the 121st US Congress
stories.about: Elections for the United States Senate will be held on November 7, 2028, with 34 of the 100 seats being contested in regular elections, the winners of which will serve 6-year terms in the United States Congress from January 3, 2029, to January 3, 2035, which will include the entire term of the president who wins the 2028 presidential election and the first two years of the 2032 presidential election winner's term. Senators are divided into three classes whose terms are staggered so that a different class is elected every other year. Class 3 senators were last elected in 2022, and will be up for election again in 2028. A special election is expected to be held in Tennessee, to fill Marsha Blackburn's unexpired Senate term. These elections will run concurrently with the 2028 United States presidential election. Democrats are defending five seats in states that voted for Donald Trump in 2024.
stories.headline: A special election is expected to be held in Tennessee, to fill Marsha Blackburn's unexpired Senate term.

stories.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
stories.about: Godzilla Minus Zero  is a 2026 Japanese epic kaiju film written, directed, and with visual effects by Takashi Yamazaki. A sequel to Godzilla Minus One (2023), it is the 39th film in the Godzilla franchise, the 34th film thereof produced by Toho, and the sixth installment in the Reiwa era. The film stars Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Hidetaka Yoshioka, Yuki Yamada, Kuranosuke Sasaki, Sakura Ando, and Miou Tanaka reprising their roles from Minus One, with Min Tanaka, Masami Nagasawa, and Jun Kunimura also starring as new characters. In the film, set in 1949, postwar Japan struggles to rebuild when it faces a new threat: King Ghidorah. Godzilla reappears and is drawn into conflict with the three-headed monster, guided through human intervention.
stories.headline: It released in Japan on November 3, 2026, and North America on November 6, 2026, also in IMAX.

stories.title: .xyz
stories.about: .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program. Its name consists of the last three letters of the Latin-script alphabet. XYZ.com and CentralNic are the registries for the domain, which was created by entrepreneur Daniel Negari. It became available to the general public on June 2, 2014, thereafter becoming widely used by tech startups, creators, and Web3 projects.
stories.headline: .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program.
